label: Updated at 8 a.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Wyndham Championship Lead
items.text: Beau Hossler leads the Wyndham Championship at 12-under after rounds of 61 and 67, one shot ahead of Ben James and Jordan Smith at 11-under with a big pack three shots back.

items.headline: Jim McLean Health Update
items.text: Legendary golf coach Jim McLean, once pronounced dead twice, has shared an emotional health update reflecting on his nearly four-decade career.

items.headline: Bryson DeChambeau's Tour Future
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau's future with LIV Golf remains uncertain, keeping questions about his PGA Tour return alive.
